thread:
Lena Ortiz: heads-up i'm landing a docs PR that consolidates our "ratecap" wording across pricing, quota, and dashboard pages. also updating alert rules to match new tier labels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/598 (internal)

Chris Mahoney: nice. are we changing any metric names or just the display labels in grafana/panels?

Lena Ortiz: just display labels and copy. metrics stay the same to avoid pipeline churn. but the dashboard thresholds (e.g., warning/critical thresholds) are being standardized so folks see consistent colors across panels.

Jules Kim: i'll need the standardized thresholds to update the alerting rules. what are we picking for the warning/critical percent of commit?

Priya Nair: proposal in the PR: warning = 70% of committed units, critical = 90%. for burst-enabled accounts, warning = 85%, critical = 98% (because burst changes effective capacity). added a short rationale in PR notes.

Chris Mahoney: that sounds reasonable. we should add a short FAQ blurb that explains burst vs committed so customers aren't confused when their dashboard shows different thresholds.

Lena Ortiz: added a small FAQ in the billing section. also included a migration checklist for internal teams: update docs copy, update grafana panels, sync alert channels, update SDK examples, send email to customers one week before enforcement.

Jules Kim: can you paste the alerting rule snippet? i'll port it to the ops repo.

Lena Ortiz: here's the Grafana alert rule we want in the docs (simplified):

```
ALERT HighRatecapUsage
IF avg_over_time((sum by (tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total[1h])) / tenant_committed_units) * 100[5m]) > 90
FOR 10m
LABELS {severity="critical"}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="Tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} near committed capacity"}
```

Lena Ortiz: note: `tenant_committed_units` is a derived series exposed by our billing exporter; docs call it `committed_units` in the sample panels.

Priya Nair: small nit 3: use `max_over_time` for spikes? otherwise avg might hide short bursts. maybe critical should use `max_over_time(...[5m])` and warning stay as avg.

Jules Kim: good call. i'll update the rule in ops and leave the docs example as both variants so users can copy whichever fits their SLOs.

Chris Mahoney: SDK snippet for sending tenant units in python? i'd like to include a ready-to-copy example in the migration / quickstart.

Lena Ortiz: added this minimal python example to the PR: 

```
# python requests example
import os
import requests

headers = {
  'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('RW_KEY')}",
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
payload = {
  'tenant_id': 'acme-corp',
  'metered_units': 1024,
  'context': {'feature': 'chat_completion'}
}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metering/report', json=payload, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

Lena Ortiz: docs comment: `metered_units` maps to billing tiers server-side; changing labels won't affect billing.

Priya Nair: linking the preview after CI? also we should coordinate with support so they can triage customers hitting the new thresholds.

ci-bot: CI passed 1 checks. docs preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/598 (expires 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Jules Kim: pulled the preview. a couple of visual nits in the panel captions and one broken internal link to the tier mapping table. flagged in PR review.

Lena Ortiz: thanks 1 fixed the link and adjusted captions to include the tier shortcodes (S/M/L/Burst).

Chris Mahoney: can we also add a short curl example next to the python snippet? many customers still copy curl from quickstarts.

Lena Ortiz: added curl example like this: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metering/report -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"acme-corp","metered_units":1024}'
```

Priya Nair: i'm going to loop in support and message them the preview + a short playbook for how to respond to threshold alerts. will also include example customer-facing copy.

Lena Ortiz: perfect. planning to merge after SQUAD sign-off. will schedule the enforcement date in the PR description (2 weeks from merge) and create a follow-up reminder to remove the 'old label' examples from docs.

ops-bot: Reminder created: remove legacy ratecap wording 2 weeks after merge. (automated)

Chris Mahoney: approved from eng docs side. :thumbsup:

Jules Kim: approved after tiny panel caption tweak.

Lena Ortiz: merging in 5m unless anyone objects. thanks all!
